title: Monotonicity of the first Dirichlet eigenvalue of regular polygons
summary: In this paper we prove that the first Dirichlet eigenvalue $λ_1^N$ of an $N$-sided regular polygon of fixed area is a monotonically decreasing function of $N$ for all $N \geq 3$, as well as the monotonicity of the quotients $\displaystyle \frac{λ_1^{N}}{λ_1^{N+1}}$. This settles a conjecture of Antunes-Freitas from 2006 [P. Antunes, P. Freitas, Experiment. Math., 15(3):333-342, 2006].
